related.title: 光子資源態工廠：多路複用的可用率
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學相位餘裕0.06rad下，10nm可接受、20nm須重新校準；同時確認輸出和穩定。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: With a teaching0.06rad margin,10nm passes and20nm needs recalibration; also verify a stable output sum. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 計算多個獨立嘗試中至少一次成功的機率，避免把期望數當可用率。
related.differenceEn: Calculate at-least-one success among independent attempts without confusing expected count with availability.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。波長1550nm，光程漂移10nm；本題已將折射率變化併入光程。 Δφ=2π×10/1550。 代入 2*pi*10/1550，得到 0.0405367 rad。相位φ=2πOPL/λ；局部線性且波長固定，溫度與應力可同時改變光程。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。每次成功率0.2，並行來源N=4；僅選一個成功來源輸出。 P可用=1−0.8⁴。 代入 1-0.8**4，得到 0.5904 dimensionless。N個獨立相同成功率p的嘗試，其可用率1−(1−p)^N；不含選路損耗。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Wavelength1550nm, optical-path drift10nm; index changes are already included in optical path. Δφ=2π×10/1550. Substituting 2*pi*10/1550 gives 0.0405367 rad. Phaseφ=2πOPL/λ; locally linear at fixed wavelength, with thermal and stress contributions to optical path. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Per-attempt success0.2 withN=4 parallel sources; select only one successful source. Pavailable=1−0.8^4. Substituting 1-0.8**4 gives 0.5904 dimensionless. N independent attempts with successp give availability1−(1−p)^N, before switching loss. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 矽電子搬運：長距離自旋保留率
related.titleEn: Silicon electron shuttling: spin survival over many transfers

related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: With a teaching0.06rad margin,10nm passes and20nm needs recalibration; also verify a stable output sum. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 從每次搬運誤差推算累積保留率，區分存活與相位相干。
related.differenceEn: Propagate per-transfer errors into survival while distinguishing population survival from phase coherence.

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。每次搬運翻轉率p=0.001，總搬運N=100；僅計算未出現任何翻轉的機率。 P無翻轉=0.999^100。 代入 0.999**100，得到 0.904792 dimensionless。獨立等機率錯誤下P保留=(1−p)^N；相關錯誤或相干誤差不符合此乘法。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Wavelength1550nm, optical-path drift10nm; index changes are already included in optical path. Δφ=2π×10/1550. Substituting 2*pi*10/1550 gives 0.0405367 rad. Phaseφ=2πOPL/λ; locally linear at fixed wavelength, with thermal and stress contributions to optical path. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. Per-transfer flip probabilityp=0.001 andN=100 transfers; calculate the probability of no flip, not final parity. Pno-flip=0.999^100. Substituting 0.999**100 gives 0.904792 dimensionless. For equal independent error probabilityPsurvival=(1−p)^N; correlated or coherent errors violate this product. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
